sql.availability.getAllForResource: SELECT rs.id, rs.org_id, rs.start_date, rs.end_date, rs.company_id, ( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(d))) FROM ( SELECT rsa.id, rsa.resource_schedule_id as "resourceScheduleId", rsa.day_of_week_id as "dayOfWeekId", dow.day_of_week as "dayOfWeek", rsa.start_time as "startTime", rsa.end_time as "endTime", rsa.archived FROM flow.resource_schedule_availability rsa inner join flow.day_of_week dow on dow.id = rsa.day_of_week_id WHERE rsa.resource_schedule_id = rs.id) d ) as resource_schedule_availability FROM flow.resource_schedule rs LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = rs.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = rs.org_id WHERE case when :orgId::int is not null then rs.org_id = :orgId else rs.user_id = :userId end and rs.company_id = :companyId
sql.availability.getWorkDays: select dow.*, (select day_of_week_id from flow.company_week_start where company_id = :companyId) as company_week_start_day_of_week_id from flow.day_of_week dow order by dow.id < (select day_of_week_id from flow.company_week_start where company_id = :companyId), id
sql.availability.insertSchedule: insert into flow.resource_schedule(company_id, user_id, org_id, start_date, end_date, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :userId, :orgId, :startDate, :endDate, :createdById)
sql.availability.getOne: SELECT rs.id, rs.org_id, rs.start_date, rs.end_date, rs.company_id, ( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(d))) FROM ( SELECT rsa.id, rsa.resource_schedule_id as "resourceScheduleId", rsa.day_of_week_id as "dayOfWeekId", rsa.start_time as "startTime", rsa.end_time as "endTime", rsa.archived FROM flow.resource_schedule_availability rsa WHERE rsa.resource_schedule_id = rs.id) d ) as resource_schedule_availability FROM flow.resource_schedule rs LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = rs.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = rs.org_id WHERE rs.id = :id
sql.availability.insertHours: insert into flow.resource_schedule_availability(resource_schedule_id, start_time, end_time, day_of_week_id, created_by_id) values (:resourceScheduleId, :startTime::timestamp, :endTime::timestamp, :dayOfWeekId, :createdById)
